d5Text:
+`
Use one ROM root with one folder per platform, such as Emulation/roms/ps2 and Emulation/roms/snes; you do not need a separate library entry for each system. With EmuDeck, point this at its Emulation/roms folder, not the wider Emulation directory. Keep shared metadata alongside it at Emulation/metadata${interfaceMarkup(', outside the ROM root, and mount that folder on each client. ROMarr keeps one catalog per platform and deduplicated artwork here, so a rename or path change does not trigger another provider lookup.')}
`
